# derondsgnr

> Product designer and builder (remote, Nigeria). Prototype-first product work — systems, interfaces, and shipped software.

## About

Deron is a product designer who builds. He works remotely from Nigeria on product systems, interfaces, and software. His process is prototype-first — he designs and ships, not just specs.

## Work

Case studies covering product design across fintech, AI tooling, HR tech, and interface systems. Each project documents the decisions, blockers, pivots, and real mechanics — not just polished outcomes.

Projects include: Dara (AI-powered bank alert parser), CareerEdge (job readiness platform), BridgePay (cross-border payments), and others.

## Writing

Blog posts on design craft, building with AI, shipping software, and what it means to work across the design-engineering boundary.

## Pages

- /: Homepage — overview of work and current focus
- /work: Case studies and project work
- /blog: Writing on design and building
- /craft: Visual explorations and design artifacts
- /now: Current status and recent activity
- /about: Background, approach, and contact
